_comment: Expert registry: persona = experts/<name>.md (projected into the workspace AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/… at session start). skills = the portable SKILLs to mount for this expert (skills/<name>/SKILL.md → the harness's skill dir); a name not yet vendored under skills/ is silently skipped. kind is informational (operator/advisor/researcher/analyst/builder/finder/creator). Order here is the @-picker order; first = default. `label` is the persona name (genius-of-the-domain naming) shown in the chrome and as @<name> in chat. `role` is the human role / job title shown next to the persona in the @-picker so users learn who's who. The slug (key) is the stable identifier used in personas/skills and never changes.
